fetches.detail: RuntimeError: No eia_api_key in config.json. Free at eia.gov/opendata/register.php. Without it, WTI and Brent fall back to FRED if a FRED key is present, and otherwise render DATA UNAVAILABLE rather than guessing.
Fed funds futures probabilities require a licensed CME feed. No free source exists. Wire FedProbSource when licensed.
Real FNMA TBA prices are licensed (Tradeweb / MBS Live / Bloomberg). MBS_* series are MODELED from the mortgage rate and Treasury curve.
MOVE is a licensed ICE index with no free daily feed.
